name: The Ivory Seat
description: A throne cut from the first moon, where every lost name remains carved beneath the frost.

name: The Hollow Seat
description: An empty throne whose sovereign stands behind it, waiting for the last claimant to fall.

name: The Sanguine Seat
description: Forged from surrendered blades and renewed by every war declared in earnest.

name: The Veiled Seat
description: Seen only in reflections, the fourth throne judges truths that cannot coexist.

name: The Verdant Seat
description: Root-bound and vacant since the Beast devoured its nameless keeper.

name: The Glass Seat
description: Its facets show every coronation except the one that will truly occur.

name: The Last Seat
description: No record agrees on its shape. The Ainul insist it has always been occupied.
